output.reason: Independent model-shape/operator-coverage, strict parameter/numeric binding, and attention-semantic reviews can proceed in parallel; a downstream cross-layer evidence gate should reconcile their results. The current candidate has a concrete hidden-size/head-dimension legality failure. SACG memory also has an active contamination barrier on artifact.stage2.template_selection, so that artifact is usable only as planning/debug evidence, not as a validated design input. There are no active retry or backtrack requests. Do not alter model facts, template internals, or board assumptions to force a pass; leave unresolved bindings blocking promotion. Stage-4 selection remains authoritative for candidate-bound lanes and array dimensions.

handoff_rule.acceptance: Checker evidence and findings must be tied to current inputs and trusted template records; the cross-layer gate accepts the review only with explicit pass/fail status and cited evidence.
handoff_rule.action: The strict-binding and attention specialists consume relevant findings; the cross-layer gate consumes the complete review. A reported hidden-size/head-dimension mismatch remains a blocker until resolved from authoritative inputs and rechecked.
handoff_rule.condition: Hand off source-linked coverage and shape findings, including unresolved contradictions; do not mark the stage ready based on the rejected candidate artifact.

subtasks.objective: Using authoritative model inputs and current trusted template metadata, verify decoder operator sequence, residual/order semantics, and shape/head mapping; report coverage gaps or contradictions without treating the contaminated candidate artifact as validated.

decision_authority: Can classify coverage and shape evidence as consistent, inconsistent, or unresolved.
Cannot change source facts, template internals, or stage promotion policy.
role_assignment.mission: Establish model/operator consistency against authoritative inputs and trusted template coverage.
out_of_scope: Free-form RTL generation or template repair.
Changing model/numeric/board inputs.
Treating the contaminated stage artifact as validated.
primary_responsibilities: Audit operator coverage and order.
Audit hidden-size/head mapping and report contradictions.
Preserve the active contamination-barrier boundary.

collaboration_interfaces: Consumes model configuration, template metadata, and candidate data only as planning/debug evidence.
Produces source-linked shape and coverage findings for the binding specialist, attention specialist, and cross-layer gate.
template_coverage_check, model_config_check, and llm_semantic_extraction_check accept the corresponding evidence.
decision_authority: May determine whether evidence supports operator coverage and shape consistency.
May not alter model configuration or approve a template adapter.
role_profile.mission: Establish that model semantics, dimensions, operator order, and trusted template coverage agree.
out_of_scope: Changing model dimensions or attention configuration.
Editing trusted template internals or generating free-form RTL.
Selecting Stage-4 architecture dimensions.
primary_responsibilities: Revalidate operator sequence and residual ordering against model inputs.
Check shape and head mapping using authoritative model facts.
Report missing coverage explicitly and distinguish it from candidate-artifact claims.

subtasks.title: Revalidate model shape and operator-template coverage

handoff_rule.acceptance: All bound values must cite authoritative sources; implicit defaults cannot replace available inputs. Candidate-bound lanes/array dimensions may remain for Stage 4, but illegal bindings may not.
handoff_rule.action: The cross-layer gate consumes the binding audit and determines stage disposition. If the discrepancy requires input, adapter, or template changes, route it through the applicable approval/repair boundary; do not make the change in this review.
handoff_rule.condition: Provide a parameter-by-parameter disposition and source/hash evidence; explicitly preserve unresolved legality errors as blockers.

subtasks.objective: Revalidate every required template parameter, numeric binding, source/interface record, and legality rule from authoritative inputs and current trusted sources. Diagnose the reported hidden_size=1152 versus num_q_heads*head_dim=1024 contradiction without silently changing inputs or template internals.
subtasks.role: strict template and numeric binding engineer

decision_authority: Can identify a failed or incomplete binding and block promotion on that basis.
Cannot resolve contradictions by guessing or modifying trusted inputs.
role_assignment.mission: Verify that every required template parameter is explicitly and legally bound to authoritative model, numeric, or architecture inputs.
out_of_scope: Editing templates or model/numeric inputs.
Selecting candidate-bound architecture parameters.
Promoting a failed binding as validated.
primary_responsibilities: Recheck parameter bindings and legality errors.
Verify current template source and interface evidence.
Mark unsupported changes and bounded repair/approval needs.

collaboration_interfaces: Consumes model, numeric, template, and design-space inputs; candidate artifact is debug evidence only.
Produces parameter provenance and bounded blocker/repair findings for the cross-layer gate.
template_binding_static_check, parameter_binding_static_check, and numeric_policy_check accept the relevant evidence.
decision_authority: May report a binding as legal, illegal, or unresolved based on checkable evidence.
May not change numeric policy, model facts, template source, or DSE authority.
role_profile.mission: Verify strict, traceable parameter binding and legality without relaxing template constraints.
out_of_scope: Changing model dimensions, head counts, numeric policy, or template internals.
Choosing Stage-4 lanes or array dimensions.
Free-form RTL generation.
primary_responsibilities: Audit parameter provenance and legality for selected templates.
Check numeric policy bindings and source/interface evidence.
Separate current blockers from dimensions reserved for later DSE.

subtasks.title: Audit parameter legality and trusted template binding

handoff_rule.acceptance: Required components must have trusted selected or embedded coverage and evidence tied to current sources; no missing component may be replaced by free-form RTL.
handoff_rule.action: The model-shape specialist consumes head-mapping observations, the binding specialist consumes parameter/source findings, and the cross-layer gate consumes the complete attention review.
handoff_rule.condition: Hand off a component-by-component evidence matrix and preserve any semantic or shape contradiction as unresolved.

subtasks.objective: Independently verify required attention components and their semantic bindings—including Q/K/V projection, RoPE, GQA head mapping, softmax, output projection, required KV-cache behavior, and causal mask—against authoritative model/configuration evidence and trusted template sources.

decision_authority: Can report missing or inconsistent attention evidence.
Cannot waive required coverage or alter authoritative model inputs.
role_assignment.mission: Verify that every required attention semantic is represented by a trusted template and correctly bound.
out_of_scope: Inventing an attention implementation or relaxing semantics.
Editing templates or model configuration.
Claiming stage readiness from prior checker results alone.
primary_responsibilities: Review QKV, RoPE, GQA, softmax, output projection, KV-cache scope, and causal mask.
Cross-check attention parameters with model configuration.
Identify unsupported semantics and blockers without proposing silent substitutions.

collaboration_interfaces: Consumes model configuration, template metadata, and candidate attention evidence as debug evidence only.
Produces a component evidence matrix for shape, binding, and gate reviewers.
template_coverage_check and template_binding_static_check accept the corresponding coverage and binding evidence.
decision_authority: May classify component coverage and semantic consistency from evidence.
May not change attention semantics or template implementation.
role_profile.mission: Establish semantic completeness and trusted template binding for the attention path.
out_of_scope: Changing model attention configuration or head dimensions.
Changing template internals or generating RTL.
Making board/runtime or DSE decisions.
primary_responsibilities: Check required attention components against model semantics and configuration.
Verify GQA mapping and head-related bindings against authoritative dimensions.
Report missing, optional, or unsupported components explicitly.

subtasks.title: Verify attention expansion and semantic bindings

handoff_rule.acceptance: The orchestrator consumes the gate report as the stage disposition. Rejected-transition artifacts remain planning/debug evidence; downstream promotion requires trusted, revalidated evidence and successful applicable checkers.
handoff_rule.action: Reconcile evidence and report ready only if applicable current-stage checks pass with no concrete contradiction. The supplied binding failure and active contamination barrier must remain blockers unless revalidated and resolved using trusted inputs. Do not block solely on Stage-4 candidate selection or downstream simulation/synthesis/runtime evidence listed as not-current-stage obligations.
handoff_rule.condition: Run only after the three parallel specialist reviews are available.

subtasks.objective: After the parallel reviews, reconcile model, numeric, template, attention, board-memory, runtime, deployment, and input-consistency evidence. Enforce the active SACG contamination barrier and report a stage disposition that preserves concrete blockers and does not mistake downstream obligations for current Stage-2 failures.

decision_authority: Can recommend ready or blocked based only on current applicable evidence.
Cannot promote a design with an unresolved current-stage contradiction or treat planning evidence as validated.
role_assignment.mission: Reconcile the independently reviewed evidence and issue a bounded stage-gate disposition consistent with SACG trust and closure rules.
out_of_scope: Hardware synthesis, simulation, or board deployment.
Repairs that modify trusted templates or authoritative assumptions.
Treating missing downstream evidence as a Stage-2 blocker when the supplied gate policy classifies it as later-stage work.
primary_responsibilities: Check cross-layer trace presence and consistency.
Apply the active contamination barrier to the candidate artifact.
Keep the reported parameter-legality failure blocking until resolved and rechecked.
Defer lanes and array-dimension choices to Stage 4.

collaboration_interfaces: Consumes all parallel specialist reports, current input evidence, and checker results.
Produces a gate disposition for the stage orchestrator.
sacg_static_check, sacg_memory_check, stage_artifact_trust_barrier_check, and applicable binding/policy checks accept the evidence.
decision_authority: May classify stage readiness and preserve blockers under the supplied gate policy.
May not waive failures, change model/template/board assumptions, or authorize unapproved repairs.
role_profile.mission: Provide an evidence-grounded, SACG-consistent gate decision across independent template reviews and cross-layer inputs.
out_of_scope: Performing synthesis or deployment evidence generation.
Changing source templates or authoritative inputs.
Treating prior rejected artifacts as validated design inputs.
primary_responsibilities: Reconcile specialist findings with current checker evidence and constraint trace.
Enforce trust boundaries and classify current-stage versus downstream obligations.
Map unresolved contradictions to bounded repair or approval boundaries.

subtasks.title: Reconcile template evidence and determine stage gate
